sections.bodyEn:
Warm greetings and welcome to this homepage of  **Kexin Xiang (Chris, 向柯鑫)**!

I am currently a Ph.D student in the [Department of Physics and Materials (PM)](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/pm/) (formerly known as Applied Physics, AP) of [The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU)](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/), Hong Kong SAR, P. R. China. I joined Professor [Feng Yan’s Organic Electronics](https://www.polyu.edu.hk/pm/people/academic-staff/prof-feng-yan/) Group in Sept. 2024 after obtaining the bachelor degree of engineering (B.Eng) from the [Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE)](https://eee.sustech.edu.cn/) of [Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech)](https://www.sustech.edu.cn/), Shenzhen, P. R. China. My current research interests focus on organic electrochemical transistors and their neuromorphic applications.
sections.bodyZh:
欢迎来到向柯鑫（Chris）的个人主页！

我现在是香港理工大学物理与材料系（前应用物理系）博士研究生。我在中国深圳南方科技大学（SUSTech）电气与电子工程系（EEE）获得工学学士学位（B.Eng）后，于2024年9月加入严峰教授的有机电子研究课题组。我目前的主要研究方向为有机电化学晶体管及其神经形态学应用。
